title: No Gaps in the Solar Dryer

pages.text: Walking past the lorry park, Adoley, Torgbui, and Fuseini noticed red chilli peppers and mango slices spread on tarpaulins right beside exhaust smoke, Harmattan dust, and settling flies. In Career Technology, Madam Kwakye challenged Basic 9 to engineer an enclosed hygienic solar dryer shaped as a right-angled triangular prism: 100 cm long, with a horizontal base 30 cm wide and a vertical back wall 40 cm high so its clear slanted top face tilted cleanly toward the sun.
sentences: Walking past the lorry park, Adoley, Torgbui, and Fuseini noticed red chilli peppers and mango slices spread on tarpaulins right beside exhaust smoke, Harmattan dust, and settling flies.

In Career Technology, Madam Kwakye challenged Basic 9 to engineer an enclosed hygienic solar dryer shaped as a right-angled triangular prism: 100 cm long, with a horizontal base 30 cm wide and a vertical back wall 40 cm high so its clear slanted top face tilted cleanly toward the sun.
pages.alt: JHS 3 students in the design room sketching an enclosed triangular-prism solar food dryer to replace roadside drying.

pages.text: Before ordering a single sheet of material, Adoley unfolded the 3D triangular prism into its flat 2D net of five faces: two congruent right-angled triangular ends plus three rectangles! First, she found the slanted roof edge using Pythagoras’ theorem: c = √(30² + 40²) = √(900 + 1,600) = √2,500 = 50 cm—warning Torgbui never to confuse the triangle’s 40 cm perpendicular height with its 50 cm slant hypotenuse! Next, she calculated the Total Surface Area (TSA): two triangular ends = 2 × (½ × 30 × 40) = 1,200 cm²; rectangular base = 30 × 100 = 3,000 cm²; vertical back = 40 × 100 = 4,000 cm²; and slanted clear top = 50 × 100 = 5,000 cm²—giving an exact TSA of 13,200 cm² (1.32 m²)!

Next, she calculated the Total Surface Area (TSA): two triangular ends = 2 × (½ × 30 × 40) = 1,200 cm²; rectangular base = 30 × 100 = 3,000 cm²; vertical back = 40 × 100 = 4,000 cm²; and slanted clear top = 50 × 100 = 5,000 cm²—giving an exact TSA of 13,200 cm² (1.32 m²)!
pages.alt: Unfolded 2D net of right-angled triangular prism labelled with dimensions (30 cm, 40 cm, 50 cm slant, 100 cm length) and total area 13,200 cm².

pages.text: Selecting materials carefully from the NaCCA Career Technology syllabus, Torgbui chose non-rusting aluminium sheet painted matte black with food-safe exterior coating for an external heat-absorbing collector surface kept separate from food contact, stainless-steel mesh for the removable drying tray, and UV-stabilised clear polycarbonate—a tough thermoplastic that softens only at high factory moulding temperatures rather than shattering like glass—for the 50 cm × 100 cm slanted glazing! Wearing leather gloves and goggles, he scribed fold allowances, cut straight edges with tin snips, filed away every sharp metal burr, and assembled the frame with appropriate fasteners and screened, adjustable ventilation. The teacher checked all food-contact surfaces and edges before use.

pages.text: Madam Kwakye then introduced a modern Smart Material from the Basic 9 curriculum to give the operator a visible temperature warning: a self-adhesive thermochromic strip stuck inside the viewing edge! “Smart materials change their properties reversibly in response to an external stimulus such as heat, light, or moisture,” she explained. “A suitable commercially specified indicator could change colour at a chosen threshold. We must calibrate it against a thermometer; one ordinary strip does not automatically show green throughout 45–60°C and red above 65°C. Drying temperatures and times depend on the fruit, slice thickness, airflow, and hygiene guidance.”

pages.text: To prove the dryer’s performance scientifically for their project portfolio, Fuseini placed a tiny battery data-logger probe inside the chamber for six hours, exported its half-hourly temperature and relative-humidity CSV file onto the lab laptop, and backed the shared project folder up to cloud storage with view-only teacher permissions. Plotting a clean line graph in Computing, Fuseini presented an example in which outdoor air at 32°C and 68% relative humidity while the dryer measured 54°C and 24%. These readings alone could not establish that drying was twice as fast or that every batch was free of contamination; the team planned repeated measurements, protected vents, and food-safety checks.

pages.alt: Fuseini at ICT computer displaying a dual-line graph (Chamber 54°C vs Outdoor 32°C) synced safely to a shared cloud project folder.

pages.text: Calculating the prism’s internal volume (Cross-sectional Area × Length = (½ × 30 × 40) × 100 = 600 × 100 = 60,000 cm³ = 60 litres of warm circulating air), the team handed two supervised demonstration dryer prototypes to the women’s fruit-processing group for further safety and performance testing at PTA exhibition day. Tasting clean, sweet, golden dried mango rings sealed in labelled pouches, parents saw how exact 3D mensuration, materials selection, and careful data collection could help address post-harvest challenges.

activities.question: A right-angled triangular prism has triangular ends of 30 cm by 40 cm (slant 50 cm) and length 100 cm. What is its Total Surface Area?
options: 13,200 cm² (1,200 cm² for two triangles + 3,000 cm² + 4,000 cm² + 5,000 cm²)
60,000 cm² (which is the volume in cm³, not surface area)
12,000 cm² (forgetting to include the two triangular end faces)

activities.question: Why is a thermochromic strip classified as a "smart material" in Career Technology?
options: It changes a physical property (colour) reversibly in response to heat
It connects wirelessly to satellites using HTML tags
It permanently melts into liquid whenever sunlight touches it once

activities.question: What is a major advantage of backing up CSV sensor logs to cloud storage?
options: Authorised users access data safely from different devices and work is preserved
Cloud storage physically cools down mango slices inside a wooden workshop
Uploading a CSV file works without any network connection anywhere

activities.prompt: Put the engineering design and testing stages of the solar dryer in chronological order.
items: Draw unfolded 5-face 2D net and calculate Total Surface Area.
Cut, deburr, and rivet aluminium sheet, mesh vents, and clear polycarbonate.
Attach thermochromic indicator strip and log temperature/humidity to CSV.
Back up test data to cloud storage and plot performance line graphs.

glossary.definition: A flat two-dimensional pattern of polygons showing every face of a 3D prism.
A plastic polymer that softens when heated and hardens when cooled, allowing reshaping.
A rough edge or ridge remaining on metal or plastic after cutting or punching.
